text: dsh-boot-resume（DSH 插件）：在宿主启动后检查近期会话，自动续跑最后一轮被中断的对话。它通过 agents 服务恢复会话并发送一条可配置的跟进消息，默认内容为“继续”；同时按会话登记状态、活动时间、冷却时间和每日次数筛选候选。适合希望 DSH 重启后自动接上未完成工作的用户。插件在本机读取会话与 workspace 数据，并保存续跑状态和日志。

dsh-boot-resume (DSH plugin) checks recent sessions at startup and resumes interrupted turns with a configurable follow-up, defaulting to “继续”. Workspace membership, age, cooldown, and daily limits constrain candidates. It stores resume state and logs locally.
DSH 重启后能自动接着跑刚才没完成的会话吗？
Can my interrupted DSH conversation continue automatically after the host restarts?
dsh-boot-resume 的功能「中断会话续跑」：启动后检查近期会话，识别未完成轮次并通过 agents.resume 和 followup 发送默认“继续”；冷却时间与每日上限约束重复续跑。

Resume the conversation a DSH restart interrupted — so you never have to type "继续" again.

[中文说明](./README.zh.md)

dsh-boot-resume README · The problem：DeepSeek Harness persists every session to disk, so the conversation history survives a restart. The **turn that was running** does not: on resume, `interruptedTurnClosers()` appends a synthetic `turn/end { reason: { kind: 'interrupted' } }` that closes the open turn, and the session then waits for your next message. Restart during work and the agent simply stops mid-thought.

dsh-boot-resume README · What this does：1. List the stored sessions of every workspace.
2. Read the tail of each one and look for an *unfinished turn*:
   - the last event is `turn/start` with no `turn/end` — the process died mid-turn, or
   - the last `turn/end` carries `reason.kind === 'interrupted'` — the marker a later resume wrote.
3. For every session that matches, `agents.resume()` it (or reuse the already-registered agent) and `agent.followup()` a short user message — `继续` by default.
dsh-boot-resume README · What this does：Nothing else in DSH is touched: no schema, no patch to core, no extra process.

dsh-boot-resume README · What it deliberately does NOT resume：| Last turn ended with | Why it is skipped |
| --- | --- |
| `reason.kind === 'user'` | you pressed Stop — resuming would fight you |
| `reason.kind === 'completed'` | the turn finished normally |
| a turn older than `maxAgeHours` | stale, likely abandoned on purpose |

An agent instance that is already `running` for that session is also skipped, so a UI that reopened the conversation first always wins.
section: What it deliberately does NOT resume

text:
dsh-boot-resume README · Guards against a crash loop：If the resumed turn crashes the host again, the next boot would resume it again — forever. Two limits stop that:

- `cooldownMinutes` — at most one automatic resume per session in that window;
- `maxPerDay` — a hard cap per session per 24 hours.

`maxResumePerBoot` and `staggerMs` keep a busy machine from starting five model turns at the same instant.

dsh-boot-resume README · Install：```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>"
pnpm add link:/path/to/dsh-boot-resume
```

then add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json` and restart the host.

dsh-boot-resume README · Configuration：All keys are optional; the defaults are shown.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: auto-continue
      name: dsh-boot-resume
      inject: [agents]

dsh-boot-resume README · Observability：Every boot writes one block to `$DSH_HOME/auto-continue/auto-continue.log`:

```
[2026-10-21T02:50:55.275Z] 发现未完成轮次 session-9ba505ca…（turn=47, 判定=open, 最后事件 …）
[2026-10-21T02:50:55.383Z] session-9ba505ca…: 已投递「继续」
[2026-10-21T02:51:00.290Z] 启动检查完成：续跑 3 个会话
```

`state.json` in the same directory holds the per-session cooldown history (delete it to clear).

dsh-boot-resume README · How the tail is read：`sessionPersistence.open(id, 'read')` + a bounded `read()` starting from the last projected seq (up to 1000 events back), falling back to a full read when the projection cache is missing or the window holds no turn boundary. Sessions are resolved from the workspace registry, so subagent and archived sessions never become candidates.

dsh-boot-resume README · Requirements：- DSH host `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`
- Host services: `agents`, plus `sessionPersistence` and `agentDefaultModel` when present
